name: Weak dollar (DXY low) + band washout — dollar-tailwind reversion (spot long)
rationale: MECHANISM (why the dollar leads crypto): the US dollar (DXY) is the global funding currency; a weak/falling dollar loosens worldwide financial conditions and is a persistent tailwind for scarce, dollar-denominated risk assets like crypto. When the dollar is weak AND crypto is momentarily washed out (bb_z stretched below its band), the washout is a dislocation against a supportive macro backdrop and snaps back. The dollar regime leads because global liquidity re-prices in FX before it shows in crypto. Distinct from dollar-weak-MOMENTUM (continuation): this is a REVERSION (buy the washout under a weak-dollar regime). Exit if the dollar turns up through its exit level (tailwind gone). DISCONFIRMER 1: if the bb_z washout alone matches the deflated Sharpe, DXY adds nothing. DISCONFIRMER 2: DXY is a slow multi-week driver — if the fit needs same-bar DXY reactivity to pay, the mechanism (a slow regime) is not what is being captured. tier0 macro; low-confidence until OOS.
catalyst: dxy is BELOW a fitted ceiling (weak dollar = looser global conditions) while bb_z shows a downside washout.
